fact: Angola sent a delegation led by Secretary of State Ângelo Miguel Buta to the 7th Plenipotentiary Conference of the African Telecommunications Union in Abuja, which ended 24 July with the election of the ATU Secretary-General for 2026-2030.
title: Plenipotenciários da ATU elegem secretário geral para impulsionar governação digital em África
publisher: Embassy of the Republic of Angola in Nigeria
